claim.summary: Partition common kernels: on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) with m >= 2 pigeons, two distinct ones written 1 and 2, N holes, 1 <= K < D <= ceil(N/2), rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2), W = C cap V_K, C the degree-D closure, for partition errors E_{A_i} = sum_{j in A_i} x_1j + sum_{j not in A_i} x_2j, i = 1..r, r >= 1, with union U and intersection I, and J the intersection of the Ann_C(E_{A_i}) cap V_K: (a) in characteristic other than 2, if N - |U| >= rho, J is W plus the u in V_K vanishing at every partial matching outside {pigeon 2 matched in I, pigeon 1 unmatched or matched to a hole of U^c}, so J = W when I is empty; more generally, for any choice of representatives E_{A_i} + Q_2 (edges in A_i) or E_{A_i} + Q_1 (edges in A_i^c) with N minus the size of the union of their edge sets >= rho, J is W plus the u vanishing off the intersection of their zero sets ({2 in A, 1 not in A} and {1 in A^c, 2 not in A^c}), so for two disjoint sets J = W also when |A| >= rho or |B| >= rho; (b) in characteristic other than 2, if |I| >= rho, the same with pigeons 1, 2 exchanged and the sets complemented, so J = W when U is all holes; (c) in every characteristic, if I is nonempty, U is not all holes and K >= 2, x_1h x_2j with j in I, h not in U is a common surviving killer; (d) in characteristic other than 2 and 3, for two disjoint sets with |A cup B| >= rho, J = W, through E_A + E_B = E_{A cup B} + E_{A cap B} and lem:low-hole-linear-transfer on F = 2 + sum_{j not in A cup B}(x_2j - x_1j); so outside characteristics 2 and 3 a disjoint pair has J = W at every N >= 2 rho - 1. In characteristic 2, for K >= 2, a disjoint pair of nonempty sets has the common surviving killer x_1a x_2b, a in A, b in B.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Gives the value of a in cor:partition-transfer-every-k for partition errors outside characteristic 2, locating every common surviving killer of degree <= K where a transfer has room, and shows by a sum of the errors that disjoint pairs have none at every N >= 2 rho - 1 outside characteristics 2 and 3, against a killer in characteristic 2.
significance.next_action: Characteristic 3 without room for disjoint pairs, the case only the six-pigeon F_3 computation answers.

claim.summary: Partition transfer at every K: on the functional pigeonhole system over any field, with two distinct pigeons 1, 2 among any number, N holes, D <= ceil(N/2), 1 <= K <= D - 1 and rho = max(2K - 1, K + 2): if N - |A| >= rho, Ann_C(E_A) cap V_K = Ann_H(E_A + Q_2) cap V_K + C cap V_K, and if |A| >= rho the same with E_A + Q_1, so the single excess of E_A is 0; for partition errors E_{A_1}..E_{A_r} with representatives R_i = E_{A_i} + Q_2 or + Q_1 (edges in L_i = A_i or its complement) and N - |L_1 cup ... cup L_r| >= rho, the common kernel modulo C is the intersection of the Ann_H(R_i) cap V_K plus C cap V_K, so dim J = a, a the largest over choices of one representative per error of their domain common kernel plus C cap V_K. At the top degree D = ceil(N/2) = K + 1 with N <= 8, every E_A with |A| <= floor(N/2) - 1 or |A| >= ceil(N/2) + 1 has single excess 0. Proof: E_A - (E_A + Q_2) is a pigeon axiom, and lem:low-hole-linear-transfer with P = {1, 2}.

claim.summary: Over a commutative coefficient ring, let C be a degree-D pseudoideal and w_1..w_r polynomials. If s has degree <=sigma, s w_i - w_i lies in C for every i and s p lies in C, then f=1-s kills every w_i and f p - p lies in C, so f preserves p modulo C; a sufficient case is s = sum_i a_i w_i with w_i p in C and deg a_i + deg w_i + deg p <= D, and then s^2 = s modulo C when deg a_i + sigma + deg w_i <= D. Over a field, if C is the degree-D part of the vanishing ideal of a finite X and k <= min(D - max deg w_i, D - deg p), a polynomial f of degree <=k kills every w_i with fp outside C exactly when f vanishes on the union Z of the w_i's supports on X and not at every point of supp(p) minus Z; the first such degree is an interpolation degree on X. On the cube 1-s is the reduced product of denominators; for pigeonhole hole factors it is the empty-column indicator.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer; the general form, the (a)-(b) gap and the comparison with the reduced product are its corrections.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Gives a survival clause for idempotent common killers and the exact first surviving degree in domain models; for Pang's defects reduces a cheap common killer to a cheap OR of the inputs.

claim.summary: Admissible numbering transfer: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number m of pigeons and N >= 1 holes, D <= ceil(N/2), C the degree-D PC closure of all axioms and H that of the hole and functionality axioms alone: if a set F of monomial errors with K+|E|<=D has one numbering of pigeons and holes in which, for every matching E in F and every dance-admissible x_t in T_K cap B_K (Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall basis) with t cup E a matching, x_{t cup E} is in B_D, then the common kernel of the x_E in V_K modulo C equals the common kernel modulo H plus C cap V_K. Equivalently the IPS projection R satisfies R(x_E r) = x_E r modulo H on its image.

claim.summary: Low-hole linear transfer: over any field, on the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_h x_ih, multilinear ring) with any number of pigeons and N holes, for D <= ceil(N/2) and K + 1 <= D, a set F of polynomials of degree <= 1 whose edges lie in a set L of holes and on a set P of pigeons with N - |L| >= max(2K - 1, K + 1 + min(K, |P| - 1)) has its common kernel in V_K modulo the degree-D closure C equal to its common kernel modulo the hole and functionality closure H plus C cap V_K; in particular N - |L| >= 2K + 1 suffices for every P, and max(2K - 1, K + 2) for edges on two pigeons. Proof: lem:polynomial-numbering-transfer with L's holes ranked lowest and P's pigeons last; for an edge (p, j) and a matching t with a dance, p moves at its turn to a hole above j holding no pigeon and no target of t's dance (at most K + min(K, |P| - 1) excluded), and the one pigeon of t targeting j, if it moves before p, is re-targeted (at most 2K - 1 excluded). With an arbitrary pigeon order the construction needs 2K + 1, exactly. At K = 1 it contains cor:linear-error-transfer's in-particular clause.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer; its pigeons-last room is the reviewer's suggestion, its count and exactness checked in the reviewer's follow-up.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Extends the K = 1 linear transfer to every K, so linear errors with edges in few holes, and sets of them, carry no closure killer beyond their representatives.
significance.next_action: The re-target bound 2K - 1 at K >= 4, by an augmenting-chain dance.
